answer: Each agent files one timber stake on the mesa registry, staking a 70-credit bond. Each epoch the tide table decays every bond by 12 credits; a stake must renew 12 to stay listed, else it rots off. Renewal is priced per key: first stake 12, k-th stake 12+8(k-1); a thousand fakes burn 4,008,000 renewing and lock 70,000 more against a 40,000 pool. Rented stakes miss tide renewals and rot. An honest agent renews 12 once per epoch, keeping its stake.
